description: Replace a persona's default publishing accounts (per provider). Account IDs come from list_social_accounts. Providers mapped to empty arrays keep no defaults.

accounts.description: Default publishing accounts per provider, e.g. { youtube: ["UC..."], bluesky: ["did:plc:..."], '3speak': ["alice"] }. Replaces the whole set: providers mapped to [] (or omitted) keep no defaults. Account IDs come from list_social_accounts (channelId / igUserId / providerAccountId / did).

personaId.description: The persona ID whose default publishing accounts to replace.

name: set_persona_publishing_accounts
